newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn feedlot cattle mostly up $1 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn feedlot cattle mostly up $1 - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were mostly $1.00 per cwt higher, compared with Monday's close, USDA said. Trade moderate. Demand moderate to good. Seller interest moderate. Offerings light.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1150-1300 lbs 73.00-74.00 some Choice to 75.00. Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1050-1200 lbs 73.00-74.00.
Carcass Basis (weight only) compared with Monday's close, slaughter steers and heifers were $1.00 higher, instances $2.00 higher.

Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1150-1300 lbs 118.00-119.00 Holstein - (weight only) Select to mostly Choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs 2 ld 108.00 Holsteins - ( grade and weight) Choice 2-3 1250-1450 lbs ld 110.00 Select 2-3 1250-1450 lbs 102.00.
Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1050-1200 lbs 118.00-119.00.
